tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background in every product. Body text sits on it in `ink`.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs and inputs that sit on `paper`.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, table header rows, code blocks and quiet tag fills.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders. At least 3:1 on `paper` and `paper-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `paper-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions and metadata on any paper ground.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps and captions on `paper` and `paper-raised`. Never for body copy.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring on every interactive element, offset 2px. Solid, at least 3:1 on every paper ground.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `success-bg`. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Success banners and badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `warning-bg`.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning banners and badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, destructive buttons and invalid input borders on any paper ground and `danger-bg`.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Error banners and badges.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons on any paper ground and `info-bg`.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Info banners and badges.
